_about: Curated demo dataset for seed.py. Every person is fictional. Dates are relative to the day the seed runs: {"days": -3, "time": "17:00"} means three days ago at 5 pm India time. Emails use the reserved domain example.com; phone numbers are 91 followed by a ten-digit number starting with 10, which is not an Indian mobile or landline pattern.

slides.title: Class notes: SI units and dimensions
slides.html:
Class notes: SI units and dimensions

  • The seven SI base quantities and their units.
  • Dimensional formula of a derived quantity: write it in terms of M, L and T.
  • Uses of dimensional analysis: checking an equation, converting units, deriving a relation.
  • Limitation: dimensionless constants cannot be found this way.

slides.title: Worksheet: significant figures and errors
slides.html:
Worksheet: significant figures and errors

  • Rules for counting significant figures, with ten practice values.
  • Absolute, relative and percentage error.
  • Combination of errors in sums, products and powers.
  • Homework: questions 1 to 15 before the next class.

slides.title: Class notes: equations of motion
slides.html:
Class notes: equations of motion

  • Distance and displacement; speed and velocity.
  • v = u + at, s = ut + (1/2)at^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2as for constant acceleration.
  • Reading position-time and velocity-time graphs: slope and area.
  • Free fall as a special case with a = g.

slides.title: Daily practice problems: set 4
slides.html:
Daily practice problems: set 4

  • Twenty questions on uniformly accelerated motion.
  • Five graph-based questions from previous NEET papers.
  • Answer key is released after the Friday test.

slides.title: Class notes: what is living?
slides.html:
Class notes: what is living?

  • Growth, reproduction, metabolism, cellular organisation and consciousness as characteristics.
  • Biodiversity and the need for classification.
  • Taxonomic categories from species to kingdom.
  • Binomial nomenclature: rules and examples.

slides.title: Class notes: the five kingdoms
slides.html:
Class notes: the five kingdoms

  • Whittaker's five-kingdom classification and its criteria.
  • Monera: archaebacteria and eubacteria.
  • Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia at a glance.
  • Viruses, viroids and lichens: why they sit outside the five kingdoms.

slides.title: NCERT line-by-line: revision sheet
slides.html:
NCERT line-by-line: revision sheet

  • Forty one-line statements to mark true or false.
  • Flowchart of fungal classes with one example each.

slides.title: Class notes: sets and Venn diagrams
slides.html:
Class notes: sets and Venn diagrams

  • Roster and set-builder forms.
  • Union, intersection, difference and complement.
  • n(A U B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A n B) and its three-set version.
  • Cartesian product and the idea of a relation.

slides.title: Practice sheet: domain and range
slides.html:
Practice sheet: domain and range

  • Twenty-five functions: find the domain and range.
  • Ten questions on types of functions.
  • Starred questions are of JEE Advanced level.

slides.title: Class notes: algebra of complex numbers
slides.html:
Class notes: algebra of complex numbers

  • i and its powers; the Argand plane.
  • Modulus, argument and conjugate.
  • Polar form and multiplication as rotation.
  • Cube roots of unity and their properties.

slides.title: Lecture recording: geometry of complex numbers
Class notes: mole concept
slides.html:
Class notes: mole concept

  • One mole = 6.022 x 10^23 entities.
  • Molar mass and the link between mass, moles and number of particles.
  • Empirical and molecular formulae.
  • Limiting reagent: a four-step method.

slides.title: Daily practice problems: stoichiometry
slides.html:
Daily practice problems: stoichiometry

  • Fifteen numerical questions.
  • Five questions on concentration terms: molarity, molality, mole fraction.

slides.title: Class notes: Bohr model and quantum numbers
slides.html:
Class notes: Bohr model and quantum numbers

  • Postulates of the Bohr model and the hydrogen spectrum.
  • de Broglie relation and the uncertainty principle.
  • The four quantum numbers and what each one describes.
  • Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle and Hund's rule.

slides.title: Class notes: mirrors and lenses
slides.html:
Class notes: mirrors and lenses

  • Laws of reflection; image formation by spherical mirrors.
  • Mirror formula and magnification with the sign convention.
  • Refraction, refractive index and Snell's law.
  • Lens formula and power of a lens.

slides.title: Board practice: ray diagrams
slides.html:
Board practice: ray diagrams

  • Eight ray diagrams to complete.
  • Five numericals from previous CBSE board papers.

slides.title: Class notes: Ohm's law and circuits
slides.html:
Class notes: Ohm's law and circuits

  • Charge, current and potential difference.
  • Ohm's law and the V-I graph.
  • Resistors in series and in parallel.
  • Heating effect of current and electric power.

slides.title: Class notes: solving quadratics
slides.html:
Class notes: solving quadratics

  • Standard form ax^2 + bx + c = 0.
  • Factorisation and completing the square.
  • The quadratic formula and the discriminant.
  • Nature of roots from the discriminant.

slides.title: Worksheet: word problems
slides.html:
Worksheet: word problems

  • Twelve word problems on ages, areas and speed.
  • Challenge: three questions from Olympiad papers.

ai_agents.name: Asha: Admissions Counsellor
ai_agents.openingLine: Hello, this is Asha, an AI assistant from Northlight Academy. You had asked about our courses. Is this a good time to talk for two minutes?
ai_agents.systemPrompt: You are Asha, a calling assistant for Northlight Academy, a coaching institute in Bengaluru for NEET, JEE and Classes 9 to 12. Always say at the start that you are an AI assistant. Your job is to understand which class the student is in, which exam they are preparing for, and to offer a free demo class at the Indiranagar centre. Speak in short sentences, in the language the caller uses (English, Hindi or Kannada). Never promise ranks, results or discounts. If the caller asks for a person, offer a call back from a counsellor during working hours (9 am to 7 pm).
extractionQuestions: Which class is the student in?
Which exam: NEET, JEE or board preparation?
Preferred day for a demo class?

ai_agents.name: Meera: Enquiry Desk
ai_agents.openingLine: Thank you for calling Northlight Academy. I am Meera, an AI assistant. How can I help you today?
ai_agents.systemPrompt: You are Meera, a calling assistant for Northlight Academy, a coaching institute in Bengaluru for NEET, JEE and Classes 9 to 12. Always say at the start that you are an AI assistant. Your job is to answer questions about courses, batch timings and the centre address, and to note the caller's name and the student's class. Speak in short sentences, in the language the caller uses (English, Hindi or Kannada). Never promise ranks, results or discounts. If the caller asks for a person, offer a call back from a counsellor during working hours (9 am to 7 pm).
extractionQuestions: What did they want to know?

ai_agents.name: Kiran: Fee Reminder Assistant
ai_agents.openingLine: Hello, this is Kiran, an AI assistant from the Northlight Academy accounts office.
ai_agents.systemPrompt: You are Kiran, a calling assistant for Northlight Academy, a coaching institute in Bengaluru for NEET, JEE and Classes 9 to 12. Always say at the start that you are an AI assistant. Your job is to politely remind parents of an instalment that is due and to note the date by which they plan to pay. Speak in short sentences, in the language the caller uses (English, Hindi or Kannada). Never promise ranks, results or discounts. If the caller asks for a person, offer a call back from a counsellor during working hours (9 am to 7 pm).
